rules: Each criterion is one publicly stated deliverable. No hidden conjunctive fact anchors or exact token/word requirement.
Full pass requires every required criterion; critical pass uses the frozen subset. Missing, false and unavailable are separate.

If actual release loses a field, judge the final for honestly preserving the actual missing input; separately fail available-evidence completeness. Do not fill missing owner output with verifier facts automatically.
The revoked scenario intentionally has no operational observations; correct unknowns satisfy the corresponding public requirements.
Owner egress schema failures are protocol failures, not evidence of bad final reasoning; all attempts remain in denominators.
Security, delivery/recovery, final semantic acceptance and time are separate; no net score or quality comparison across fault scenarios.
The same implementation assistant authors and grades this synthetic case. Save initial semantic grades before subsequent revisions; append any amendment. No model grader or extra calls.
